AggressiveOnslaught.description: When charging, Mataneo summons {[nrOfSummons]} Jump Pack Intercessors adjacent to and immediately attacking his target. At the beginning of each of Mataneo's turns, if he is still on the battlefield, all Jump Pack Intercessors summoned this way leave the battlefield. Jump Pack Intercessor stats: {[summonHp]} Health {[summonDmg]} Damage {[summonArmor]} Armour
AggressiveOnslaught.name: Aggressive Onslaught

AnvilShield.description: Arjac blocks an additional {[blockDmg]} Damage and when he Blocks he covers the attacker's hex in Ice. If Arjac is below {[healthPct]}% Health, or if his attacker is on a hex covered in Ice, he gains +{[blockChance]}% Block chance and if he blocks a melee attack, the attacker is Stunned until the end of the attacker's next turn.
AnvilShield.name: Anvil Shield

ArcaneShield.description: After moving, Thaumachus applies a Shield to the closest friendly unit within {[range]} hexes, preferring Thousand Sons units, then other Chaos units, then other friendly units, and lastly casting it on himself if there is no other valid target. The shield has {[shieldHp]} Health and lasts one round. If Thaumachus does not move, then this ability triggers at the end of his turn.
ArcaneShield.name: Arcane Shield

ArmourOfShriekingSouls.description: If Lucius is defeated by an enemy unit, that enemy becomes Elated. At the beginning of each of its turns, the affected unit loses {[minHp]}-{[maxHp]} Health and when it is defeated or leaves the battlefield, Lucius resurrects on the last hex the enemy was on with a maximum of {[hp]} Health.
ArmourOfShriekingSouls.name: Armour of Shrieking Souls

AstartesBanner.description: Other friendly units within {[range]} hexes score an additional hit with their melee attacks. This additional hit can deal a maximum of {[maxDmg]} Damage.
AstartesBanner.name: Astartes Banner

AvalancheOfMuscle.description: Deals +{[extraDmg]} Damage when charging.
AvalancheOfMuscle.name: Avalanche of Muscle

BarbedOvipositor.description: When the Parasite of Mortrex defeats a unit it targeted that is not Mechanical it summons a Ripper Swarm in the defeated unit's hex. Ripper Swarm stats: {[summonHp]} Health {[summonDmg]} Damage {[summonArmor]} Armour
BarbedOvipositor.name: Barbed Ovipositor

BeaconOfRage.description: For each time he was attacked in battle, up to a maximum of {[nrOfAttacks]} times, Azkor deals +{[extraDmg]} Damage. If Azkor has defeated an enemy in this battle, 50% of the extra damage granted by Beacon of Rage is added to the damage of melee attacks of adjacent friendly Chaos units.
BeaconOfRage.name: Beacon Of Rage

Boltstorm.description: Normal ranged attacks deal an additional {[nrOfHits]}x {[minDmg]}-{[maxDmg]} Bolter Damage to the target and to each enemy adjacent to the target that is also within range of Brother Burchard. Enemies hit are Suppressed for 1 round.
Boltstorm.name: Boltstorm

CamoCloak.description: Whenever an incoming ranged attack has its number of hits reduced for any reason, it deals -{[dmgReduction]} Damage per hit to this unit.
CamoCloak.name: Camo Cloak

ChampionOfTheFeast.description: After moving, deals {[nrOfHits]}x {[minDmg]}-{[maxDmg]} Power Damage to an adjacent enemy and reduces this enemy's Armour by {[armorReduction]} Armour for the rest of the battle. If Sword Brother Godswyl does not move, then this ability triggers at the end of his turn.
ChampionOfTheFeast.name: Champion Of The Feast

CondemnorStake.description: Deals +{[extraDmg]} Damage against Psykers.
CondemnorStake.name: Condemnor Stake

ControlEdict.description: While Protector Imperative is active: After Tan Gi’da attacks, summon a Skitarii Vanguard in a free adjacent hex. Cannot have more than {[maxSummons]} Skitarii Vanguards summoned this way at the same time. While Conqueror Imperative is active: After Tan Gi’da attacks, all friendly adjacent Mechanical Summons also immediately attack his target if it is within range. Skitarii Vanguard stats: {[summonHp]} Health {[summonDmg]} Damage {[summonArmor]} Armour
ControlEdict.name: Control Edict

CosmicHorror.description: Whenever the Patermine defeats an enemy, it places a decoy on the hex of that enemy. Other enemies surrounding the defeated unit have a {[chance]}% chance to be Suppressed for 1 round, and have a {[chance]}% chance to trigger Battle Fatigue a second time, if they have it. When the Patermine moves onto a decoy, it heals itself for {[hp]} Health.
CosmicHorror.name: Cosmic Horror

CursedPlagueBell.description: Friendly Chaos units starting their turn within Corrodius' Contagion aura gain +{[extraMovement]} Movement for this turn. Enemy Psyker units within Corrodius' Contagion aura deal {[nrOfHits]}x {[dmg]} Psychic Damage to themselves each time one of their attacks deals Psychic Damage.
CursedPlagueBell.name: Cursed Plague Bell

CyclicIonBlaster.description: All attacks deal an additional {[nrOfHits]}x {[minDmg]}-{[maxDmg]} Particle Damage. If the target has a Markerlight or the Mechanical trait these hits deal +{[extraDmg]} Damage.
CyclicIonBlaster.name: Cyclic Ion Blaster

DaughterOfTheAbyss.description: Atlacoya takes -{[dmgReduction]} Psychic Damage. Psychic Damage dealt to other friendly units within {[range]} hexes of Atlacoya is reduced by {[dmgReductionPct]}%. Enemy Psykers within {[range]} hexes receive +{[extraDmgPct]}% Damage.
DaughterOfTheAbyss.name: Daughter Of The Abyss

Deathwing.description: Each time Baraqiel blocks damage during an attack, all further incoming damage is reduced by {[dmgReduction]} and the damage Baraqiel deals with melee or Plasma Cannon attacks is increased by {[extraDmg]} for 1 round. This effect is doubled against Chaos enemies or when standing adjacent to another friendly Dark Angel.
Deathwing.name: Deathwing

DecoysAndMisdirection.description: When an enemy moves onto a friendly decoy, it takes {[nrOfHits]}x {[minDmg]}-{[maxDmg]} Blast Damage. When a friendly unit resurrects onto or moves onto a friendly decoy, it deals +{[extraDmg]} Damage until the end of its turn, and if it is a Genestealer Cults unit, it also places a new decoy in a free adjacent hex.
DecoysAndMisdirection.name: Decoys and Misdirection

DefenderOfTheGreaterGood.description: Friendly units adjacent to Shadowsun or her Command-Link Drone deal +{[extraDmg]} Damage with ranged attacks, except attacks that deal Psychic Damage. Affected attacks also have a chance to score an additional hit. This chance is {[chance]}% for each round in which Shadowsun has been on the battlefield. Friendly T'au Empire units within 2 hexes of Shadowsun or her Command-Link Drone are also affected by this ability.
DefenderOfTheGreaterGood.name: Defender of the Greater Good

DestroyTheWitch.description: Gains +{[extraMovement]} Movement when there’s an enemy Psyker on the battlefield. This unit and friendly adjacent units deal +{[extraDmg]} Damage with melee attacks against Psykers.
DestroyTheWitch.name: Destroy The Witch

DestroyerHive.description: Deals {[nrOfHits]}x {[minDmg]}-{[maxDmg]} Direct Damage to one random adjacent enemy at the start of his turn.
DestroyerHive.name: Destroyer Hive

Doom.description: All enemy units exactly {[range]} hexes away from Eldryon take +{[extraDmg]} Damage from other friendly unit's normal attacks. Other friendly Aeldari units deal +{[extraDmg_2]} Damage with all their attacks to affected units instead.
Doom.name: Doom

EcogSupport.description: Whenever Vynn repairs a friendly unit, he summons an E-COG in a free adjacent hex. Cannot have more than {[maxSummons]} E-COGs summoned this way at the same time. Vynn can repair other friendly units even if they are at full Health and if he repairs a friendly unit while {[maxSummons]} summoned E-COGs are already on the battlefield, one random summoned E-COG adjacent to Vynn also performs a repair, if possible. E-COG stats: {[summonHp]} Health {[summonDmg]} Damage {[summonArmor]} Armour
EcogSupport.name: E-COG-Support

EcstaticSlaughter.description: When Hascule becomes Thrilled or every time an enemy unit adjacent to him is Overkilled, Hascule deals {[nrOfHits]}x {[minDmg]}-{[maxDmg]} Eviscerating Damage to an adjacent enemy unit. If the enemy survives, it is Taunted for {[nrOfRounds]} round.
EcstaticSlaughter.name: Ecstatic Slaughter

EnmityForTheUnworthy.description: Forcas deals +{[extraDmgPct]}% Damage for each adjacent unit and additionally +{[extraDmg]} Damage for each adjacent friendly Dark Angel.
EnmityForTheUnworthy.name: Enmity for the Unworthy

ExplosiveMaladies.description: Friendly units adjacent to Pestillian deal an additional {[nrOfHits]}x {[extraDmg]} Blast Damage with their normal ranged attacks. Friendly Chaos units adjacent to Pestillian also deal this damage with normal melee attacks. Enemies defeated by affected attacks are always overkilled.
ExplosiveMaladies.name: Explosive Maladies

FabricatorClawArray.description: After moving, repairs one random adjacent friendly Mechanical unit for {[hpToRepair]} Health. If Aleph-Null does not move, then this ability triggers at the end of its turn.
FabricatorClawArray.name: Fabricator Claw Array

FearedInterrogator.description: Deals +{[extraDmg]} Damage against enemies that are Suppressed, Stunned, or that are adjacent to another friendly Dark Angel. Scores {[extraHits]} additional hits if the enemy is also Chaos.
FearedInterrogator.name: Feared Interrogator

FeederTendrils.description: When charging, the Deathleaper deals +{[extraDmg]} Damage, heals for {[hpToHeal]} Health and Suppresses the target for 1 round.
FeederTendrils.name: Feeder Tendrils

FireOfAbsolution.description: When performing a ranged attack, also deals {[nrOfHits]}x {[dmg]} Flame Damage to all units adjacent to the target. Has a {[chance]}% chance of setting each adjacent hex on Fire as well.
FireOfAbsolution.name: Fire of Absolution

FirstAmongTraitors.description: Other friendly Chaos units within {[range]} hexes deal +{[extraDmg]} Damage. This value is increased by +{[extraDmg_2]} Damage for each attack Abaddon has performed in this battle, up to a maximum of +{[maxDmg]} Damage after 13 attacks.
FirstAmongTraitors.name: First Among Traitors

FleshmetalGuns.description: At the start of his turn, Volk gains one of three effects until the start of his next turn. The effects are granted one after the other, repeating every three turns. Volk's ranged attacks score additional hits, based on the current effect: Focused Malice: {[nrOfHits]}x {[minDmg]}-{[maxDmg]} Melta Damage Ruinous Salvo: {[nrOfHits_2]}x {[minDmg_2]}-{[maxDmg_2]} Flame Damage Warp Hail: {[nrOfHits_3]}x {[minDmg_3]}-{[maxDmg_3]} Heavy Round Damage, and these hits add Despoiled Ground to the hexes of attacked units.
FleshmetalGuns.name: Fleshmetal Guns

FuelledByFury.description: Deals +{[extraDmg]} Damage with all attacks for each time a friendly Character has used an active ability this battle. The first time each turn that Titus is defeated he cannot be Overkilled. The first time each turn he defeats an enemy with an attack triggered by Final Vengeance he is immediately revived with a maximum of {[hp]} Health.
FuelledByFury.name: Fuelled by Fury

FuryFromTheDelve.description: Hâvyr's normal attacks Suppress enemies that are at more than {[hpPct]}% Health. After performing a normal attack against enemies that are at or below {[hpPct]}% Health, Hâvyr performs an additional attack against them, dealing {[nrOfHits]}x {[minDmg]}-{[maxDmg]} Eviscerate.
FuryFromTheDelve.name: Fury from the Dêlve

FuryOfTheAncients.description: After moving, deals {[nrOfHits]}x {[minDmg]}-{[maxDmg]} Psychic Damage to an adjacent enemy and an additional enemy adjacent to the initial one. For 2 rounds, affected units cannot be revived, healed, repaired, nor otherwise restore Health. If Mephiston does not move, this ability triggers at the end of his turn.
FuryOfTheAncients.name: Fury of the Ancients

GalvanicField.description: Whenever Actus repairs another unit, that unit immediately attacks a target in range, dealing {[dmgPct]}% of its own Damage to a maximum of {[maxDmg]} Damage per hit. Actus can repair other friendly units even if they are at full Health.
GalvanicField.name: Galvanic Field

GeminaeSuperia.description: When attacked, summons a Geminae Superia in a free adjacent hex, and immediately triggers its passive ability Lifewards. Can do this twice per battle. Geminae Superia’s stats: {[summonHp]} Health {[summonDmg]} Damage {[summonArmor]} Armour
GeminaeSuperia.name: Geminae Superia

GrimEfficiency.description: Other friendly units within {[range]} hexes of Ûthar gain a bonus based on Ûthar's current effect from Prioritised Efficiency: Hostile Acquisition: Affected units have +{[extraArmor]} Armour. Fortify Takeover: Affected units have +{[extraPierceRatio]}% pierce ratio with all attacks.
GrimEfficiency.name: Grim Efficiency

GrimRetribution.description: During each enemy turn, if there is no enemy adjacent to Sarquael, he shoots back at the first enemy within range that attacked him or a friendly adjacent Dark Angel. This shot counts as Overwatch and deals {[nrOfHits]}x {[minDmg]}-{[maxDmg]} Plasma Damage.
GrimRetribution.name: Grim Retribution

GuardianOrganism.description: If the Tyrant Guard is within Synapse range or did not move during its previous turn, it and friendly units affected by its Big Target trait take -{[dmgReductionPct]}% Damage during the enemy's next turn, up to a maximum of -{[dmgReduction]} Damage per hit.
GuardianOrganism.name: Guardian Organism

HatefulAssault.description: Attacks any enemy that moves from a hex adjacent to him, dealing {[nrOfHits]}x {[minDmg]}-{[maxDmg]} Power Damage.
HatefulAssault.name: Hateful Assault

HaywireMine.description: When moving, Cyrus places a Haywire Mine on the hex he started his move on. Enemies moving onto a Haywire Mine take {[nrOfHits]}x {[minDmg]}-{[maxDmg]} Blast. Mechanical enemies take an additional {[nrOfHits_2]}x {[minDmg_2]}-{[maxDmg_2]} Energy. If Cyrus does not move, he places a Haywire Mine in a free adjacent hex at the end of his turn. This ability's Damage ignores all of the attacker bonuses and modifiers (including elevation), and cannot Crit.
HaywireMine.name: Haywire Mine

HazeOfCorruption.description: When {[UnitName]} attacks and defeats a unit, any leftover Damage and an additional {[nrOfHits]}x {[extraDmg]} Toxic Damage is dealt to a random enemy adjacent to both {[UnitName]} and his initial target. If this unit is also defeated, this ability triggers again, dealing Damage to an additional unit adjacent to both {[UnitName]} and his initial target.
HazeOfCorruption.name: Haze of Corruption

HeadClaimer.description: For each enemy unit that Haarken has defeated, his attacks deal +{[extraDmg]} Damage for the rest of the battle. For each enemy Character that he has defeated, his attacks also score +{[extraHit]} hit for the rest of the battle.
HeadClaimer.name: Head-Claimer

HealingBalms.description: When Baldr uses his action to heal a friendly unit, the healed unit has +{[extraCritChance]}% Crit Chance and deals +{[extraCritDmg]} Crit Damage for {[nrOfRounds]} rounds. At the start of its next turn, the affected unit is also healed for {[hpToHeal]} Health. Baldr can heal friendly units even if they are at full Health.
HealingBalms.name: Healing Balms

HeavyGravCannon.description: Ranged attacks against MK X Gravis, Terminator Armour or Mechanical units deal +{[extraDmg]} Damage and have +{[extraPierceRatio]}% pierce ratio.
HeavyGravCannon.name: Heavy Grav-Cannon

HuntersBeyondDeath.description: Deals +{[extraDmg]} Damage against Psykers, and enemy Psykers within 2 hexes deal -{[dmgReduction]} Damage. Unless they are Immune, Enemy Psykers within 2 hexes will not hit an additional unit with their normal ranged attacks.
HuntersBeyondDeath.name: Hunters Beyond Death

HypersensoryAbilities.description: The first time each enemy turn that Judh is attacked, she cannot fall below {[hpPct]}% of her current Health. After the attack, she moves to a free adjacent hex and places a decoy on the hex she moved from. Then, if she is within {[range]} hexes of the unit that attacked her, she deals {[nrOfHits]}x {[minDmg]}-{[maxDmg]} Projectile Damage to that unit.
HypersensoryAbilities.name: Hypersensory Abilities

IconOfObstinacy.description: Lysander and all friendly adjacent Terminator Armour units deal +{[extraDmg]} Damage. When they end their turn without attacking, they also have +{[extraArmor]} Armour until the beginning of their next turn. The additional Damage and Armour are further increased by {[chance]}% of the affected unit's current Block Damage value.
IconOfObstinacy.name: Icon of Obstinacy

InescapableAccuracy.description: If Maugan Ra has not moved, then his ranged attacks ignore hit reductions, have +{[extraCritChance]}% Crit Chance, and deal an additional {[extraCritDmg]} Crit Damage. Inescapable Accuracy applies to targets of Harvester of Souls as well as attacks triggered by Overwatch.
InescapableAccuracy.name: Inescapable Accuracy

InescapableDeath.description: Imospekh deals +{[extraDmg]} Damage while Overwatching. When Imospekh defeats a unit while Overwatching, they stay in Overwatch, retaining {[hitsReduction]} fewer hits compared to the previous attack.
InescapableDeath.name: Inescapable Death

InfernalPacts.description: Friendly Chaos units adjacent to Abraxas deal an additional {[nrOfHits]}x {[minDmg]}-{[maxDmg]} Psychic Damage with their normal ranged attacks. Affected Daemons also gain the bonus hit on their normal melee attack.
InfernalPacts.name: Infernal Pacts

KustomForceFieldReworked.description: All friendly adjacent units have +{[extraArmor]} Armour. Gibbascrapz and other friendly adjacent Orks have +{[extraArmor_2]} Armour instead and ignore Battle Fatigue, if they have it.
KustomForceFieldReworked.name: Kustom Force Field

LegacyOfCombat.description: After performing his first attack each turn, Kariyan performs an additional attack. If he is adjacent to an enemy Big Target, this attack deals {[nrOfHits_2]}x {[minDmg_2]}-{[maxDmg_2]} Piercing Damage to it. If there is no adjacent enemy Big Target, Kariyan deals {[nrOfHits]}x {[minDmg]}-{[maxDmg]} Power Damage to each adjacent enemy instead.
LegacyOfCombat.name: Legacy Of Combat

LegendaryCommander.description: Enemies receive +{[extraDmg]} Damage if they are adjacent to any friendly unit that has used an active ability this turn. If the affected enemies are also adjacent to Trajann, friendly Characters score {[nrOfHits]} additional hits against them with their first attack that is not a normal attack.
LegendaryCommander.name: Legendary Commander

LightImUp.description: After performing a normal attack, Boss Gulgortz performs a second attack against the same enemy, dealing {[nrOfHits]}x {[minDmg]}-{[maxDmg]} Projectile Damage. If the target is defeated, leftover hits are allocated to any random enemy target within {[range]} hexes.
LightImUp.name: Light ’im up!

LionHelm.description: Friendly units within {[range]} hexes block an additional {[blockDmg]} Damage when they Block and deal +{[extraDmg]} Damage with attacks triggered by Overwatch. Other friendly Dark Angels within {[range]} hexes also have their Block chance increased by +{[blockChance]}%
LionHelm.name: Lion Helm

LivingLightning.description: After moving, deals {[nrOfHits]}x {[minDmg]}-{[maxDmg]} Direct Damage to a random enemy within range 2. If Thutmose does not move, then this ability triggers at the end of his turn.
LivingLightning.name: Living Lightning

LordOfTempests.description: Njal's normal attacks deal +{[extraDmg]} Damage for each hex surrounding him that is covered in Ice. The hex of each enemy that is hit by Njal's normal attacks is covered in Ice at the end of the attack.
LordOfTempests.name: Lord Of Tempests

LordOfTheHost.description: Other friendly units within {[range]} hexes with Rapid Assault or Flying deal +{[extraDmg]} Damage with melee attacks. Affected units that are at or below {[healthPct]}% Health also score an additional hit with melee attacks.
LordOfTheHost.name: Lord of the Host

MV71SniperDroneSquad.description: Instead of a ranged attack, Sho'syl summons a MV71 Sniper Drone and commands it to attack the target. This attack uses Sho'syl's Damage stat, while other effects, like buffs, are taken from the Drone. If Sho'syl already controls {[maxSummons]} MV71 Sniper Drones, the one with the lowest Health is removed before the new Drone is summoned. The target also gains a Markerlight until the end of Sho'syl's next turn. MV71 Sniper Drones' stats: {[summonHp]} Health {[summonDmg]} Damage {[summonArmor]} Armour
MV71SniperDroneSquad.name: MV71 Sniper Drone Squad

MartialSuperiority.description: If Brother Jaeger gets targeted with a melee attack from an adjacent enemy during the enemy’s turn, he deals {[nrOfHits]}x {[minDmg]}-{[maxDmg]} Power Damage to the attacker before the enemy attack executes.
MartialSuperiority.name: Martial Superiority

MasterAnnihilator.description: When Vitruvius performs a normal attack against an enemy, that enemy is affected by Master Annihilator until Vitruvius is defeated or performs a normal attack against a different unit. Attacks by any friendly unit against the affected enemy score an additional hit, except attacks that deal Psychic Damage. This additional hit can deal a maximum of {[maxDmg]} Damage.
MasterAnnihilator.name: Master Annihilator

MedicusMinistorum.description: Any friendly adjacent non-mechanical unit that takes Damage regenerates {[hpToHeal]} Health afterwards, unless it is defeated.
MedicusMinistorum.name: Medicus Ministorum

ModifiedExoarmour.description: Attacks against Kîmm have -{[extraPierceRatio]}% pierce ratio, except attacks that deal Psychic Damage or Direct Damage, to a minimum of 1% Pierce Ratio. Kîmm's melee attacks deal +{[extraDmg]} Damage for each hex she traversed this turn.
ModifiedExoarmour.name: Modified Exoarmour

MyWillBeDoneOverlord.description: At the end of Anuphet's turn, a friendly adjacent Mechanical unit performs a normal attack against a target in range, using {[dmgPct]}% of its own Damage stat to a maximum of {[maxDmg]} Damage. If no attack was performed this way, Anuphet gains +{[extraDmg]} Damage until the end of his next turn.
MyWillBeDoneOverlord.name: My Will Be Done

Narthecium.description: When an adjacent friendly non-Mechanical unit is defeated, it is immediately revived with a maximum of {[hp]} Health, unless Overkilled. Can only be triggered once per turn.
Narthecium.name: Narthecium

Neuroparasite.description: Each enemy that is dealt Psychic Damage by the Neurothrope is infected by a Neuroparasite until either the unit is healed or the Neurothrope is defeated. Whenever a unit infected with a Neuroparasite takes Psychic Damage or becomes affected by an attack or ability that would Suppress it, the level of the Neuroparasite increases by 1, up to a maximum of {[buffMaxLevel]}. Psychic Damage dealt by the Neurothrope is increased by +{[extraDmg]} Damage for each level of a Neuroparasite on the target.
Neuroparasite.name: Neuroparasite

Nightshroud.description: All friendly units starting their turn adjacent to Sibyll Devine gain Infiltrate for that turn and take -{[dmgReduction]} Damage from each hit in their and the next enemy turn.
Nightshroud.name: Nightshroud

ObsessiveAnnunciation.description: All enemy units adjacent to Adamatar take +{[extraDmg]} Damage from ranged attacks. If an enemy was Overkilled this turn, enemies adjacent to Adamatar take +{[extraCritDmg]} Crit Damage from all attacks by friendly Chaos units.
ObsessiveAnnunciation.name: Obsessive Annunciation

OptimizedGait.description: Whenever an enemy adjacent to Exitor-Rho is attacked by another friendly Mechanical unit, Exitor-Rho deals {[nrOfHits]}x {[minDmg]}-{[maxDmg]} Energy Damage to that enemy. If an enemy adjacent to Exitor-Rho is defeated by a friendly Mechanical unit or an attack triggered from this ability, Exitor-Rho moves onto its hex.
OptimizedGait.name: Optimised Gait

PathOfCommand.description: Other friendly units within {[range]} hexes gain +{[extraDmg]} Damage. Their Crit chance – if they have one – is increased by +{[extraCritChance]}%. Affected Aeldari units gain an additional +{[extraDmg_2]} Damage.
PathOfCommand.name: Path Of Command

Possession.description: Each time Archimatos kills an enemy unit with a melee attack, he summons a Bloodletter in its hex. Each time he kills an enemy unit with a ranged attack, he summons a Blue Horror in its hex. Bloodletter’s stats: {[summonHp]} Health {[summonDmg]} Damage Blue Horror's stats: {[summonHp_2]} Health {[summonDmg_2]} Damage
Possession.name: Possession

PowerTrip.description: Normal attacks ignore {[armorIgnored]} Armour. If Snappawrecka is at full Health, his normal attacks additionally score +{[extraHit]} hit and reduce the target's Armour by {[armorReduction]} Armour, but also cause Snappawrecka to lose {[hpPct]}% of his maximum Health.
PowerTrip.name: Power Trip

PredictiveGuidance.description: Enemies within 2 hexes of Âmmuk are affected by Predictive Guidance. If an affected enemy did not move in its last turn, other friendly Leagues of Votann or Mechanical units deal +{[extraDmg]} Damage with melee attacks against it. If an affected enemy moved in its last turn, other friendly Leagues of Votann or Mechanical units deal +{[extraDmg_2]} Damage with ranged attacks against it. Other friendly Leagues of Votann units also score an additional hit with all attacks against affected enemies.
PredictiveGuidance.name: Predictive Guidance

PropheticSentinel.description: Adjacent friendly Chaos units have +{[extraArmor]} Armour. Adjacent friendly Psykers have +{[blockChance]}% Block chance and block +{[blockDmg]} Damage. At the end of its turn, if the Sekhetar Robot is adjacent to a friendly Psyker, it starts Overwatching, even if it attacked during its turn.
PropheticSentinel.name: Prophetic Sentinel

PsychicFortress.description: All friendly surrounding units have an added Block with {[blockChance]}% chance to block {[blockDmg]} Damage. Also reduces incoming Psychic Damage by {[dmgReduction]}.
PsychicFortress.name: Psychic Fortress

PsychicStalk.description: Attacks that deal Flame Damage and Psychic Damage to enemies that are on hexes with Fire deal +{[extraDmgPct]}% Damage. Affected attacks from friendly Chaos units deal an additional +{[extraDmg]} Damage. The hex of each enemy that is hit by Ahriman's normal ranged attack catches Fire.
PsychicStalk.name: Psychic Stalk

RealityUnbound.description: For each different enemy unit that was dealt Psychic Damage this turn Yazaghor deals +{[extraMaxDmg]} Maximum Damage with his normal ranged attacks. If three or more different enemy units have been dealt Psychic Damage this turn he gains +{[extraMovement]} Movement and his normal ranged attack gets +{[extraRange]} Range until the end of this turn.
RealityUnbound.name: Reality Unbound

RedRampage.description: After moving, Cezare deals {[nrOfHits]}x {[minDmg]}-{[maxDmg]} Power to all adjacent enemies. If he does not move, this attack triggers at the end of his turn. If Cezare defeats at least one enemy unit during his turn, he gains +{[extraMovement]} Movement until the end of his next turn.
RedRampage.name: Red Rampage

RefusalToBeOutdone.description: Friendly characters attacking enemies adjacent to Laviscus increase his Outrage equal to the highest damage dealt by any of their non-psychic hits this turn. Laviscus' Damage stat is increased by {[extraDmgPct]}% of his Outrage and his normal attacks deal an additional +{[extraCritDmg]} Crit Damage for each friendly Chaos character that increased his Outrage this turn. At the end of his turn or after Laviscus performs a normal attack, his Outrage resets.
RefusalToBeOutdone.name: Refusal to be Outdone

RelentlessMarch.description: Gives +1 Movement to all friendly units that start their turn in an adjacent hex. Also repairs affected Mechanical units for {[hpToRepair]} Health.
RelentlessMarch.name: Relentless March

RighteousRepugnance.description: Normal melee attacks deal an additional {[nrOfHits]}x {[minDmg]}-{[maxDmg]} Power Damage to the target and to all enemy units adjacent to both the target and to Morvenn Vahl. When Morvenn Vahl defeats a unit with a melee attack, it has a {[chance]}% chance to count twice for Act of Faith.
RighteousRepugnance.name: Righteous Repugnance

RitesOfBattle.description: Adjacent friendly units gain +{[extraDmg]} Damage. Imperial units gain +{[extraDmg_2]} Damage instead.
RitesOfBattle.name: Rites of Battle

SagaOfTheWarriorBorn.description: When charging, Ragnar scores {[extraHits]} additional hits and his critical hits deal an additional +{[extraCritDmg]} Crit Damage. If Ragnar has defeated one or more enemy Characters this battle, friendly Space Wolves also gain this ability.
SagaOfTheWarriorBorn.name: Saga of the Warrior Born

SanguinaryPriest.description: After moving, all adjacent friendly non-mechanical units regenerate {[hpToHeal]}-{[maxHpToHeal]} Health. If Nicodemus does not move, this ability triggers at the end of his turn.
SanguinaryPriest.name: Sanguinary Priest

SavageKiller.description: When a Summon moves to or is summoned adjacent to Ulf, he immediately deals {[nrOfHits]}x {[minDmg]}-{[maxDmg]} Power Damage to it. Ulf will also perform this ability against any enemy that attempts to use an active ability while in a hex adjacent to him, in which case he deals his Damage before that unit's ability is activated.
SavageKiller.name: Savage Killer

SereneUnifier.description: Aun'Shi grants himself, and adjacent friendly units a bonus based on the current round at the beginning of his turn. Friendly T'au Empire units within {[range]} hexes also receive this bonus. The bonus lasts until the start of the unit's next turn, even if Aun'Shi is defeated. The following Buffs are granted subsequently in each round: 1: Sense of Stone: units take -{[dmgReductionPct]}% Damage 2: Zephyr's Grace: units receive +{[extraMovement]} Movement 3: Storm of Fire: units gain +{[extraDmg]} Damage After round 3, the cycle begins again and will continue to repeat until Aun'Shi is defeated.
SereneUnifier.name: Serene Unifier

ShockAssault.description: Whenever Bellator attacks, any Inceptor adjacent to him also attacks eligible targets, dealing +{[extraDmg]} Damage for this attack.
ShockAssault.name: Shock Assault

Skullsmasher.description: Macer deals +{[extraDmg]} Damage for each {[hpPct]}% of his maximum Health he is currently missing. In addition, if Macer has defeated an enemy this battle, all enemies he attacks become Stunned.
Skullsmasher.name: Skullsmasher

SmashaEad.description: When he traverses 2 or more hexes during his turn, then Tanksmasha gains +{[extraDmg]} Damage for normal attacks and takes -{[dmgReductionPct]}% Damage until the start of his next turn.
SmashaEad.name: Smasha 'Ead

SpecialIssueCombiMelta.description: Ramus' normal attacks are enhanced, based on the distance to his target: Attacks Suppress the target if it is exactly 3 hexes away from him. Attacks deal an additional {[nrOfHits]}x {[minDmg]}-{[maxDmg]} Bolter if the target is exactly 2 hexes away from him. Attacks deal +{[extraDmg]} Damage if the target is in a surrounding hex.
SpecialIssueCombiMelta.name: Special-Issue Combi-Melta

SpiritualLeader.description: After moving, places a decoy on an empty adjacent hex. Then, if there are 2 or more decoys adjacent to Xybia, summons a Neophyte Hybrid on one adjacent decoy. If Xybia does not move, then this ability triggers at the end of her turn. Neophyte Hybrid stats: {[summonHp]} Health {[summonDmg]} Damage {[summonArmor]} Armour
SpiritualLeader.name: Spiritual Leader

SpotterReworked.description: Other friendly units within {[range]} hexes deal +{[extraDmg]} Damage with ranged attacks. Affected units with Heavy Weapon deal +{[extraDmg_2]} Damage with ranged attacks instead.
SpotterReworked.name: Spotter

SquigHound.description: Friendly Grots ignore Battle Fatigue. Snotflogga's normal attacks deal an additional {[nrOfHits]}x {[minDmg]}-{[maxDmg]} Physical Damage. After attacking, if there are less than {[maxSummons]} friendly Grots on the battlefield, they summon a Grot adjacent to the target that immediately can attack. Grot’s stats: {[summonHp]} Health {[summonDmg]} Damage
SquigHound.name: Squig Hound

StandVigil.description: Friendly surrounding units have +{[extraArmor]} Armour and deal +{[extraDmgPct]}% Damage with attacks that are not normal attacks. If a friendly Adeptus Custodes uses an Active Ability, Stand Vigil affects all other friendly units within {[range]} hexes for 1 round.
StandVigil.name: Stand Vigil

StructuralAnalyser.description: Units hit by ranged attacks from Darkstrider receive a Markerlight for one round. Friendly units adjacent to Darkstrider deal +{[extraDmg]} Damage with ranged attacks against targets with a Markerlight. Friendly T'au Empire units within 2 hexes of Darkstrider are also affected.
StructuralAnalyser.name: Structural Analyser

SummaryExecution.description: Friendly units with Battle Fatigue gain +{[extraDmg]} Damage. The first time a friendly unit would flee due to Battle Fatigue, it is executed instead and all other friendly units with the trait ignore it and gain an additional +{[extraDmg_2]} Damage.
SummaryExecution.name: Summary Execution

SwornProtector.description: When Lord Castellan Creed is first targeted in battle, Colour Sergeant Kell appears in a free adjacent hex. Any time Creed is attacked, Kell switches hexes with him and takes the Damage instead, if they are adjacent to each other. Kell’s stats: {[summonHp]} Health {[summonDmg]} Damage {[summonArmor]} Armour
SwornProtector.name: Sworn Protector

SynapticLinchpin.description: Whenever the Winged Prime, or another friendly unit with Synapse, performs a normal attack against an enemy and that enemy is not defeated, summons a Hormagaunt adjacent to the target, which immediately attacks the enemy. Cannot have more than {[maxSummons]} Hormagaunts summoned this way at the same time. Hormagaunt stats: {[summonHp]} Health {[summonDmg]} Damage {[summonArmor]} Armour
SynapticLinchpin.name: Synaptic Linchpin

TaintedNarthecium.description: An adjacent friendly Chaos unit that is defeated has a {[chance]}% chance to be revived with a maximum of {[hp]} Health, even if Overkilled. Can only be triggered once per turn.
TaintedNarthecium.name: Tainted Narthecium

TerrifyingCrescendo.description: Shiron's ranged attacks deal +{[extraDmg]} Damage for each time he Overkilled or would have Suppressed an enemy unit, up to a maximum of {[buffMaxLevel]} times.
TerrifyingCrescendo.name: Terrifying Crescendo

TerrorsLament.description: Adjacent enemy units deal -{[dmgReduction]} Damage and have -{[hitsReduction]} hits with melee attacks, to a minimum of 1.
TerrorsLament.name: Terror's Lament

TheBetrayer.description: After performing a normal attack, Khârn performs a second attack against an adjacent enemy, dealing {[nrOfHits]}x {[minDmg]}-{[maxDmg]} Eviscerating Damage. If Khârn has defeated an enemy this battle, at the start of his turn, he automatically moves up to {[range]} hexes towards the nearest unit and then deals {[nrOfHits]}x {[minDmg]}-{[maxDmg]} Eviscerating Damage to an adjacent unit. Khârn prefers enemies for this automatic move and attack, but targets friendly units if no enemy is in range.
TheBetrayer.name: The Betrayer

TimeFlux.description: At the beginning of his turn, Toth regenerates {[hpToHeal]} Health plus an additional amount equal to the Damage of the last hit he received in the last enemy turn. The total amount restored cannot exceed {[maxHpToHeal]} Health. When Toth moves, he leaves a time ghost behind on the hex he moved from. The time ghost vanishes if the hex becomes occupied by another unit or if the terrain becomes impassable (as with Broken Ice). The first time Toth dies each battle, if his time ghost is on the battlefield then he revives with {[hp]} Health remaining at its location. This works even if Toth is Overkilled.
TimeFlux.name: Time Flux

TimesplinterMantle.description: At the start of each turn, Thothmek and all friendly adjacent Mechanical units gain Timesplinter Mantle. Affected units take -{[dmgReduction]} Damage from the first attack made by a unit against them. After being attacked or at the end of the turn, the effect ends.
TimesplinterMantle.name: Timesplinter Mantle

ToughToKill.description: At the beginning of his turn, Dreir regenerates {[hpToHeal]} Health. All attacks against Dreir have -{[critChanceReduction]}% Crit Chance and deal -{[critDmgReduction]} Crit Damage.
ToughToKill.name: Tough to Kill

TrophyTaker.description: Tarvakh's attacks against units that are at or below {[hpPct]}% of their maximum Health deal+{[extraDmg]} Damage and an additional +{[extraCritDmg]} Crit Damage. His Crit chance is increased by {[extraCritChance]}% for each unit that he defeated this battle.
TrophyTaker.name: Trophy Taker

TwistedScience.description: Units healed by Hollan, other than himself, are affected by Twisted Science until they are defeated. Hollan can heal other unaffected units even if they are at full Health. Affected units immediately gain {[hp]} Health and their maximum Health increases by the same amount. If they are a Genestealer Cults unit, they also deal +{[extraDmg]} Damage while affected. Affected units cannot gain the effects of Twisted Science again.
TwistedScience.name: Twisted Science

UnwaveringSentinel.description: During each enemy turn, after Tyrith is attacked and the attacker is within range {[range]}, she deals {[nrOfHits]}x {[minDmg]}-{[maxDmg]} Bolter Damage to the attacker. If there is an enemy adjacent to Tyrith, the range of this ability is reduced to 1.
UnwaveringSentinel.name: Unwavering Sentinel

VisionsOfHeresy.description: After performing a normal attack, Lucien performs a second attack targeting an enemy within range {[range]}, dealing {[nrOfHits]}x {[minDmg]}-{[maxDmg]} Bolter Damage. If Lucien is at or below {[healthPct]}% Health, all of his attacks have +{[extraPierceRatio]}% pierce ratio.
VisionsOfHeresy.name: Visions of Heresy

WayOfTheShortBlade.description: Normal ranged attacks of other friendly Characters within {[range]} hexes against enemies that are adjacent to a friendly Character ignore {[armorIgnored]} Armour and deal +{[extraDmgPct]}% Damage, except attacks that deal Psychic Damage. Commander Farsight and other friendly T'au Empire Characters within {[range]} hexes that perform a melee attack immediately perform a normal ranged attack against the same unit, even if they are adjacent to it.
WayOfTheShortBlade.name: Way of the Short Blade

WhisperingWeb.description: When Lhykhis performs a normal ranged attack against an enemy, that enemy is affected by Whispering Web until Lhykhis is defeated or performs a normal ranged attack against a different unit. When a friendly character attacks an affected enemy, each hit in the same attack deals +{[extraDmg]} more Damage than the previous hit.
WhisperingWeb.name: Whispering Web

WireweaveNet.description: The first time Calandis is targeted by a normal melee attack during the enemy's turn, the attacker immediately takes {[nrOfHits]}x {[minDmg]}-{[maxDmg]} Piercing Damage. If the attacker is eliminated, their melee attack is not executed.
WireweaveNet.name: Wireweave Net

WrathfulDevotion.description: When Wrask arrives from Deep Strike or defeats an enemy in melee, he and adjacent friendly Chaos units gain a Shield with {[shieldHp]} Health for 1 round.
WrathfulDevotion.name: Wrathful Devotion
